nodes.name: DE search terms
nodes.notes: One item per search term. Change terms here; filters are in 'BA search'.

nodes.name: BA search
nodes.notes: Unofficial public API (github.com/bundesAPI/jobsuche-api). X-API-Key is the public client id, not a secret.

nodes.name: BA job details
nodes.notes: Full description. v4 is the details version that still answers; v6 details returns 403.

nodes.name: Map to job schema
nodes.notes: Common shape shared with the London source (P2-04).

nodes.name: UK search terms
nodes.notes: One item per title phrase. Filters are in 'Adzuna search'.

nodes.name: Adzuna search
nodes.notes: Adzuna free tier, personal job search. app_id/app_key come from the 'Adzuna' Custom Auth credential, never from this file. Attribution: every London job shown must say 'Adzuna' linked to adzuna.co.uk.

nodes.name: Map UK to job schema
nodes.notes: Flatten, de-duplicate by Adzuna id, map to the common job shape.

nodes.name: All jobs
nodes.notes: DE + UK jobs in one list, ready for scoring (P2-05).

nodes.name: Read profile
nodes.notes: profile/profile.md is git-ignored and mounted read-only. It is the only candidate text sent to Gemini.

nodes.name: Title pre-filter
nodes.notes: Cheap rule before the model: keep titles that name a product role. Saves Gemini quota.

nodes.name: Drop already seen
nodes.notes: Remembers scored job ids for 30 days in workflow static data (saved on scheduled and CLI runs). Delete and re-import the workflow to reset it.

nodes.name: Make batches
nodes.notes: Many jobs per Gemini request to stay inside the free-tier daily request limit.

nodes.name: Gemini score
nodes.notes: Gemini free tier. Key comes from the 'Gemini' Header Auth credential (x-goog-api-key), never from this file.
